description: This file defines security configuration for a Spring Boot application, setting up different security filter chains depending on the active profile ('dev' or production). It enables open access during development and restricted access with authentication for production, specifically configuring endpoints related to documentation, health checks, and the H2 database console.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up security filter chains for different profiles in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: securityFilterChainDev
methods.description: Defines a security filter chain for development profile where all endpoints are accessible without authentication.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines a security filter chain for non-dev profiles, restricting access to certain endpoints and enabling HTTP Basic authentication.
